topic: Steph Curry playing basketball in Korea against exaggerated defenses.

hook.first_words: Steph Curry played basketball in Korea
hook.first_frame: Steph Curry dribbling a basketball on court with a defender closing in
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: Steph Curry played basketball in Korea and they had no idea how to stop him.

shots.shows: Steph Curry dribbling past a defender
Defender sliding in front of Steph
Giant mascot and giant arms blocking Steph
Normal-sized player shooting into 3x larger hoop
Steph shooting and hoop spinning rapidly
Opponent shooting with tilted hoop board
Steph shooting game-winning shot into normal hoop

script: Steph Curry played basketball in Korea and they had no idea how to stop him. Instead of playing fair, this guy pulled out a device with 20 arms to defend Curry. And another teammate showed up with a 12-foot inflatable defender to block all of Steph's shots. If that wasn't enough, they built a basketball hoop three times the normal size so they could make every single shot. They even went as far as making Curry's hoop spin. But none of it mattered as Curry was still unstoppable and he hit the last shot that shocked everyone.
retention_tricks: escalating absurd visual gags (20 arms, giant inflatable, giant hoop, spinning hoop)
suspense built around whether Curry can score against rigged odds
what_makes_it_work: Absurd escalating comedic gimmicks keep viewer engaged
High-energy voiceover pairs with fast-paced comedic editing
Satisfying payoff when Curry overcomes all obstacles at the end
